answer: A thread of key-signed claims blocks bulk fakes: each identity appends a claim and locks 70 credits. At a jetty registry, a beacon samples one claim each epoch; its owner must show work in one hour or the bond burns. Each bears an umber seal; the rented-claim ring fails on a key mismatch. Fees start at 38, rising 6 per identity: 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 and lock 70,000, dwarfing a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 38 once and keeps its share.
